status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; revised by issue #523 (ADR-0040); read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: How far each cause the review confirmed reaches beyond the points the issue reports, and whether each behaviour a criterion requires conflicts with the rules the code already has — assuming no fix.

review_record.note: Only these: the module runs in a context that carries nothing else of the review.

failure.note: Written instead of the expected output when the run does not reach its goal: what the run did and why it did not reach the goal — an input it needed and was not given named as such. check-out then writes `failed` (docs/core.md > Development Lifecycle; ADR-0040 D1).
